description: This file defines the TransactionalResourceExtension class which implements ITransactionalResourceExtension. It manages transactional resources by providing methods for commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations, utilizing a resource factory registry and a resource dictionary.

classes.name: TransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: Implements ITransactionalResourceExtension, managing transactional resource lifecycle and operations.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Performs a read-only commit on a resource for a specific transaction.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the specified transaction on a resource.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction, updating its status.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction on a resource.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a resource for a transaction.

methods.name: GetResource
methods.description: Retrieves a transactional resource by resource ID, creating it if it doesn't exist.
